recipes.name: Healthier Easy Meatloaf
ingredients_raw: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Combine beef, egg, onion, milk, bread crumbs, parsley, and carrot in a large bowl. Season with salt and black pepper. Place beef mixture in the loaf pan.
Stir together brown sugar, mustard, and ketchup in a small bowl. Pour over meatloaf.
Bake in preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Healthier Easy Meatloaf
raw_recipe.description: Easy meatloaf made healthier by using lean ground beef, low-fat milk, and whole wheat bread crumbs. A no-fail recipe for the whole family and a great option for lower-calorie meatloaf.

review.reviewBody: This is my favorite meatloaf recipe. Every time I make it, it turns out really well and very flavorful. I use 99/1 extra lean ground turkey for this recipe, grate the carrot extra fine so it's almost a puree, and chop the onion really small too. It holds together really well (no crumbling) and comes out really moist.

This was really good and easy to make but don't add all the milk. I looked at other posts and didn't add any milk but in retrospect I think 1/4 cup would have been ok. I used 93% lean ground beef. I minced and sautéed the onions and carrots first in 1 tsp of veg oil. I also added a tablespoon of Worcestershire sauce to the meat mix, will probably add two next time. I did not put the brown sugar in the topping, only mustard and ketchup. The 10 minute prep time for me was very unrealistic. It was more like 35 minutes. Will definitely make this again.

I looked at Renee C’s review and will make adjustments. Next time I plan to use less milk, add 1-2tbs of worshetshire sauce, replace the ketchup and mustard with bbq sauce, and sauté the onion and carrots. Also, my “large carrot” was too much. I’m thinking maybe a half cup of shredded carrots next time.

This turned out to be a hit for dinner in feeding hungry boys. I sautéed the onions with garlic before adding to meatloaf mixture. I think the whole wheat bread crumbs added to flavor. Shredded carrot is a color and flavor plus

Didn’t hold together well. I think the recipe calls for too much milk. The recipe seemed a lot like my mothers, but I don’t remember her using milk. I’ll try it again with maybe two eggs and no milk, and I’ll remember to use aluminum foil liner. I think the brown sugarMade the pan crusty.
I made this exactly how the recipe called for except a little less milk.. it was still a bit watery but it tasted awesome. Next time I'll add a bit more bread crumbs. Will definently make it again
This meatloaf was great! I replaced the beef with ground turkey, and used almond milk instead of 1% but it came out great!

This recipe was so-so. The meatloaf really did not hold together that well, it was really moist so fell apart easily. I did use ground turkey instead of beef due to food allergies. For my picky eaters I used onion powder instead of chopped onions. It was a bit on the bland side and should have looked at reviews of the original recipe first and seasoned appropriately:/ My kids did like the sauce that was on top.
Best turkey meatloaf I ever made!

I liked this recipe, although , I would probably use less brown sugar in the future.. the only change I made was not intentional. I misjudged how much bread crumbs to use. The meat loaf was a little dense. The next time I make it, I will use less.( But I will make it again.)
 Overall, I think it is a good recipe.

My go to meatloaf recipe. The 1.5 lbs thing is a bit annoying as I buy beef in 1 pound packs but I have started to double the recipe and pack it for lunches all week long. I also chop the carrots and onions as small as possible as my 9-yr old didn't like the texture the first time around and I agree with im.
I have made this recipe several times. It is soooo easy & everyone go nuts ove it.
I didn't include the onions but the meatloaf was so easy and delicious

If you don't use all the milk they suggest, this is great. The mixture gets too soupy with a full cup of milk and only one egg. The carrots were great in there, it added a little sweetness and you couldn't really tell they were carrots. I am making this again tonight.

Agree. Didn't hold together very well and was very moist. I also used ground turkey for health reasons. I seasoned it with more of my normal seasons vs just salt/pepper so even though the consistency was not the best, it still tasted great and my hubby went back for seconds. Sauce was delicious too.
We did not care for this meat loaf.
